claim: PC saves are single files named <uid>_ShadowOfWar.sav under %LOCALAPPDATA%\WB Games\Shadow of War, starting with magic 'SOM3' and AES-CBC encrypted with a key built from a fixed template, header bytes and the 32-bit id in the filename.
evidence: PCGamingWiki save path template; convert.py: MAGIC 'SOM3', AES.MODE_CBC, filename regex for the key id.

sources.location: Game data / Save game data location

game_build_compatibility: UNKNOWN; converter targets Steam and Game Pass saves of unstated version.
verification_method: Two independent sources agree on the filename pattern. Verify on our build by checking a COPY of a save: magic bytes and filename shape only (do not touch originals).
limitations: Key material is public in the converter but we deliberately did not reproduce it. Decrypted structure (Nemesis/faction data layout) is not documented publicly; Steam reports memory edits can corrupt saves.
next_experiment: On a copied save, verify header magic; later decrypt a copy offline with an independently written reader to map top-level sections.
